note: The day shapes an applicability entry names by id, the counterpart of lights.json under REQ-PART-2: Rule 20(c) makes them the daytime signal, Annex I 6 fixes their form and size. `svg` draws each at Annex I's minimum dimensions with 1 user unit = 1 m, so a consumer scales rather than redraws; the orientation is in the id because the Rules prescribe it (a cone apex downwards is 25(e), apex upwards 26(c)(ii)).

shape:ball.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 0.6 0.6"><circle cx="0.3" cy="0.3" r="0.3" fill="#000"/></svg>

shape:cone_up.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 0.6 0.6"><path d="M0.3 0 L0.6 0.6 L0 0.6 Z" fill="#000"/></svg>

shape:cone_down.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 0.6 0.6"><path d="M0 0 L0.6 0 L0.3 0.6 Z" fill="#000"/></svg>

shape:cylinder.projection: rectangle, twice as high as wide
shape:cylinder.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 0.6 1.2"><rect x="0" y="0" width="0.6" height="1.2" fill="#000"/></svg>

shape:diamond.composition: two cones with a common base
shape:diamond.projection: rhombus, twice as high as wide
shape:diamond.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 0.6 1.2"><path d="M0.3 0 L0.6 0.6 L0.3 1.2 L0 0.6 Z" fill="#000"/></svg>

shape:flag_a.term: rigid replica of International Code flag A
shape:flag_a.projection: swallow-tailed flag, white at the hoist and blue at the fly
shape:flag_a.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1.2 1"><path d="M0 0 H0.6 V1 H0 Z" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="0.01"/><path d="M0.6 0 H1.2 L0.95 0.5 L1.2 1 H0.6 Z" fill="#0033a0"/></svg>
shape:flag_a.note: Not an Annex I shape: 27(e)(ii) prescribes it by name and fixes only its height and all-round visibility.
